entities.summary: Vladimir Viktorovich Gudev was a Russian diplomat. He served as Ambassador from the Soviet Union and later Russia to Iran from 1987 to 1993, Ambassador to Egypt from 1995 to 2000, and Ambassador to Georgia from 2000 to 2002. He died on 6 January 2022, at the age of 81.
